extracted.name: Philly Intense tuna melt
extracted.description: Elevate your toastie game – add Philadelphia Intense Garlic & Herbs to your traditional tuna sandwich for a burst of bold flavour
ingredient_lines: ½ small red onion finely sliced
instruction_lines: Butter one side of each piece of bread, then spread the Philadelphia Intense Garlic & Herbs over the other sides. Add the tuna and red onion on top on one piece of bread, then sandwich the other piece on top, buttered-sides out.
Put in a frying pan over a medium heat, and toast for 2-3 mins on each side until golden. Cut in half and serve with salad and crisps, if you like.
